1. (Currently amended) A method of providing advertisements in a traffic message, implemented using a computer processor, comprising: - obtaining, via the computer processor, traffic data having a traffic condition of a location description on a road network; - assessing, via the computer processor, a location reference code associated with the location description assigned by a traffic message supplier; - assessing, via the computer processor, an advertising reference code associated with the location reference code; - determining, via the computer processor, whether the advertising reference code is present; and - generating, via the computer processor, a traffic message having the location reference code and the advertising reference code when the advertising reference code is present.
